lead_raw_text:
The structure of Sm₂Mn₆Ge₆ (Sm(MnGe)₃) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6₃/mmc (No. 194), with 14 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Mn centers in a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 geometric neighbors (2 Ge, 4 Mn, 6 Sm), while Ge centers have 9 neighbors (3 Ge, 3 Mn, 3 Sm) and Sm centers have 18 neighbors (6 Ge, 6 Mn, 6 Sm). Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Ge and Mn polyhedra, and corner- and face-sharing between Ge and Sm polyhedra. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 14 sites.
